using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

pair<ll, ll> best_rational(ll x, ll y, ll n) {
    long double best = 1e100L;
    ll a = 0, b = 1;
    ll i = 1;
    while (i <= n) {
        ll prod = i * x;
        ll rem = prod % y;
        ll dist = rem < y - rem ? rem : y - rem;
        double cur = (double)dist / (double)i;
        if (best > cur) {
            best = cur;
            b = i;
            a = (rem <= y - rem) ? prod / y : prod / y + 1;
        }
        ++i;
    }
    return {a, b};
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
    cin.tie(0);
    ll x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    auto ans = best_rational(x, y, n);
    cout << ans.first << "/" << ans.second << "\n";
    return 0;
